verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents broad programmatic surfaces. The Query API returns the same calculated results as web-app reports, and there are raw-event and profile export APIs, a Feature Flags API, JQL custom queries, GDPR deletion/retrieval APIs, and a hosted MCP server that can create dashboards. None of this shows the API matches everything the UI can do. Missing for 10: explicit UI/API parity statement, documented API for configuration and admin tasks (e.g., session replay sampling, cohort and report management), a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Query API allows you to obtain the same calculated and formatted results that you see from a report in our web app.
The Mixpanel Query API endpoints can: Filter or break down Events
Use the Feature Flags API to assign your users to variants for experiments, rollout, and releases.
Create a new dashboard with text cards and reports
To export raw event data, use the Raw Event Export API.
